question: Are FF++ source-selected and isolated CDF-development-selected best epochs close?
claim: They are not uniformly close: the two DINOv2 developers differ by17/19epochs, while short CLIP/EfficientNet windows constrain observed gaps.

panels.role: Full completed-development comparison and window boundary
panels.input: all12completed developer trajectories, paired source/CDF best epochs

panels.role: Temporal explanation of source-fit versus transfer divergence
panels.input: all27+25epoch rows of both DINOv2 developers; source and CDF AUC

scope: Development diagnostic supplement, not formal5seed TEST or new model selection.
exclusions: No completed trajectory omitted from panel a. Panel b intentionally explains the DINO counterexample; full102epoch rows retained as source data.
uncertainty: No seed aggregates or sampling CIs; separate deterministic observed histories. No inference about population equality.
style_reuse: Style-only inheritance from project plotting code, no reused statistical transform.
